macros.name: pstCircleABC
macros.doc: Draws the circle crossing three points (the circum circle) and put its center O. The effective drawing is controlled by the boolean parameter DrawCirABC (by default true).

macros.name: pstCircleABR
macros.doc: The macro \pstCircleABR draws the circle of given radius length R, through two given nodes A and B, then outputs the circle center O.

macros.name: pstDistAdd
macros.doc: The macros \pstDistAdd and \pstDistSub are used to get the addition and subtraction of the given segments AB and CD.

macros.name: pstDistDiv
macros.doc: The macro \pstDistDiv is used to get the length ratio of the given segments AB and CD, you can pass the ratio to macro \pstProportionNode , or setup the ratio to parameter DistCoef in macro \pstTranslation , or pass the ratio to any \pstDist * macros which need a λ parameter.

macros.name: pstDistSub
macros.doc: The macros \pstDistAdd and \pstDistSub are used to get the addition and subtraction of the given segments AB and CD.

macros.name: pstEllipse
macros.doc: The Macro \pstEllipse is used to draw a Standard Ellipse with center O from angleA to angleB , going counter clockwise.

macros.name: pstGeneralHyperbolaAbsNode
macros.doc: The macro \pstGeneralHyperbolaAbsNode is used to draw the nodes whose abscissa are the given value x1 on General Hyperbola.

macros.name: pstGeneralHyperbolaOrdNode
macros.doc: The macro \pstGeneralHyperbolaOrdNode is used to draw the nodes whose ordinate are the given value y1 on General Hyperbola.

macros.name: pstGeneralIParabolaLineInter
macros.doc: The macro \pstGeneralIParabolaLineInter is used to find the intersections C and D of the parabola and the given line AB.

macros.name: pstGeneralParabolaAbsNode
macros.doc: The macro \pstGeneralParabolaAbsNode is used to draw a node whose abscissa is the given value x1 on parabola.

macros.name: pstGeneralParabolaOrdNode
macros.doc: The macro \pstGeneralParabolaOrdNode is used to draw a node whose ordinate is the given value y1 on parabola.

macros.name: pstHyperbola
macros.doc: The macro \pstHyperbola is used to draw a Standard Hyperbola with Center O, the half of the real axis a, the half of the imaginary axis b. The parameter angleX is used to truncate the width of the figure, it should be setup from 0 to 90.

macros.name: pstHyperbolaLineInter
macros.doc: The macro \pstHyperbolaLineInter is used to find the intersections C and D of the hyperbola and the given line AB.

macros.name: pstHyperbolaPolarNode
macros.doc: The macro \pstHyperbolaPolarNode is used to find the polar point T of chord AB on the hyperbola.

macros.name: pstIHyperbola
macros.doc: The macro \pstIHyperbola is used to draw a Standard Conjugate Hyperbola with Center O, the half of the real axis a, the half of the imaginary axis b. The parameter angleY is used to truncate the height of the figure, it should be setup from 0 to 90.

macros.name: pstIHyperbolaTangentNode
macros.doc: The macro \pstIHyperbolaTangentNode is used to find the tangent point A and B of point T outside of the hyperbola.

macros.name: pstInterFC
macros.doc: Puts a point at the intersection between the function f and the circle of centre O and radius OA.

macros.name: pstInterFF
macros.doc: This function put a point at the intersection between two curves defined by a function. x0 is an intersection approximated value of the abscissa.

macros.name: pstInterFL
macros.doc: Puts a point at the intersection between the function f and the line (AB).

macros.name: pstInterLC
macros.doc: Draw the one or two intersection point(s) between the line (AB) and the circle of centre O and with radius OC.

macros.name: pstInterLL
macros.doc: Draw the intersection point between lines (AB) and (CD).

macros.name: pstIParabola
macros.doc: The macro \pstIParabola is used to draw a Standard Conjugate Parabola from y1 to y2 with Vertex O, the half of the focus chord axis abs(p).

macros.name: pstLineAA
macros.doc: The macros \pstLineAA and \pstLineAS draw a new line with one node, the slope angle between the line and the horizontal axis, or the slope gradient of the line, and create a new node B on the line.

macros.name: pstLineCoef
macros.doc: The macros \pstLineCoef is used to draw a line ax + by + c = 0 with the given coefficents a, b, c, and create two new node A, B on the line.

macros.name: pstOrtSym
macros.doc: Draws the symmetric point in relation to line (AB).

macros.name: pstParabola
macros.doc: The macro \pstParabola is used to draw a Parabola from x1 to x2 with Vertex O, the half of the focus chord axis abs(p).

macros.name: pstParabolaPolarNode
macros.doc: The macro \pstParabolaPolarNode is used to find the polar point T of chord AB on Parabola P.

macros.name: pstParabolaTangentNode
macros.doc: The macro \pstParabolaTangentNode is used to find the two nodes A and B on the Parabola through the point T.

macros.name: pstRotation
macros.doc: Draw the image of Mi by the rotation of center O and angle given by the parameter RotAngle .
